name: Suupaa
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood supermarket: a business-hours notice, a first day working the register, a point-card info sheet, a trial self-checkout notice, a delivery service plan guide, checkout manners, teaching a junior the self-checkout, the history of the point-card system, a service guide, a self-checkout trend column, a hybrid discount-day system, a reflection on trust, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
